name: Semantic search
summary: Finds files by what they mean, not only by the words they contain.
description: Finds files by what they mean, not only by the words they contain. Needs a model and a runtime: one button in the Plugins panel downloads them (checked by SHA-256), or you place them by hand (see docs/semantic.md). This helper itself never connects to the network.
approval_note: Receives the text of your indexed files (secrets masked, excluded files never) from Lookout and keeps an encrypted vector index. Loads a runtime DLL and a model file from its own folder after checking their SHA-256. It reads no files itself.
